mapper.select: SELECT ga.general_account_id AS generalAccountId, ga.general_customer_id AS generalCustomerId, ga.account_no AS accountNo, ga.account_type AS accountType, ga.status AS status FROM general_account ga JOIN general_customer gc ON ga.general_customer_id = gc.general_customer_id WHERE ga.general_account_id = #{generalAccountId} AND gc.ci_hash = #{ciHash}
